{{Top|leg}}
The '''Second Battle of Brightday''' was an event that occurred during the [[Waymancy Storm]] in the [[Brightday system/Legends|Brightday system]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|fleet]] managed to hold the line against enemy forces.

[[Darsius]] may have fought in this battle, in command of several [[Line of battle|lines]] of [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]].
